result:
I’d make it impossible for people to dehumanize each other.

Not by controlling thoughts, but by making every other person feel unmistakably real: their fears, histories, dignity, and inner life as vivid as your own. So much cruelty, indifference, and violence becomes possible only when someone else is turned into an abstraction first. If that step vanished, the world still wouldn’t be perfect—but it would be much harder to hurt each other casually.
